developmentFindings: Godot dot-assigned dictionary keys are StringNames. Accept them as text, while rejecting lossy non-JSON types and cyclic values without changing a profile.

Generic full-precision Godot JSON changed a real item baseRoll from 0.011704753153026104 to 0.0117047531530261. The independent cross-engine comparison detected it. The final wrapper exchanges binary64 bits privately and retains ordinary JSON files.
Existing progression hosts observe numeric values as Godot floats; preserving that representation is a regression check.
The item definition pack uses id while its crafting and skill peers use contentId. The final manifest checks all three identifiers against the frozen save.
Untrusted text beyond the adapter limit is refused before VM dispatch: the actual Godot allocator count is unchanged on these calls.
